$comment: Seed index for the Global Discovery Engine. Every entry below was read from its public GitHub repository page on the stated researchDate; licence and description are transcribed from that page, not guessed. Fields that were not visible are recorded as UNKNOWN. This file is a DISCOVERY POINTER INDEX - it is not a claim that any capability is verified. Capability claims here carry evidenceBasis and are downgraded by the evidence engine accordingly.
researchMethod: Public GitHub repository landing page read over HTTPS. No source tree was downloaded, so no capability here is class VERIFIED.

entries.name: playwright
entries.description: Framework for web automation and testing that drives Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.
strength: Explicitly positioned for use by AI agents
limitations: Browser binaries must be installed before use
Capability claims here read from the repository landing page only

entries.name: playwright-mcp
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server that lets an LLM automate browser interactions through structured accessibility snapshots rather than screenshots.
strength: Speaks MCP, so it plugs into an agent host without custom glue
Accessibility-snapshot-first, which is cheaper and more reliable for an agent than pixel reasoning
limitations: Snapshot-first design means it is not itself an image differ
Tool list read from the landing page, not executed

entries.name: axe-core
entries.description: Accessibility engine for automated web UI testing that integrates with existing test environments to find WCAG compliance issues.
strength: Runs inside an existing test environment rather than replacing it
limitations: Library, not a runner - it needs a browser driver supplied around it
MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft, so copied files stay MPL

entries.name: pa11y
entries.description: Automated accessibility testing tool that runs accessibility tests on web pages from the command line or from Node.js.
strength: Runs standalone from the CLI with no test harness required
limitations: LGPL-3.0-only carries linking obligations that need legal review before bundling

entries.name: lighthouse
entries.description: Analyzes web apps and web pages, collecting modern performance metrics and insights on developer best practices.
strength: Emits numeric, comparable metrics rather than prose
Covers performance and best-practice checks in one run
limitations: Its accessibility coverage is a subset of a dedicated a11y engine

entries.name: jest-image-snapshot
entries.description: Jest matcher that performs image comparisons using pixelmatch for visual regression testing, behaving like Jest snapshots.
strength: Baseline-and-diff workflow is already the shape visual regression needs
limitations: Couples the capability to the Jest runner

entries.name: ambit
entries.description: Meta-MCP server that maps and audits AI agent infrastructure by building a capability DAG, with prerequisite modelling, near-miss detection, combo unlocks, SPOF analysis and goal-path routing.
strength: Prior art for capability DAGs, near-miss detection and combo unlocks
limitations: Answers 'what can my current environment do', not 'what should I acquire from the global ecosystem' - the direction this project needs is the inverse
v0.1 policy: concept reference only, no code reuse
